comment: Replaces the default logo at the top of the admin menu with your uploaded image.
modal: Uploads a custom logo shown at the top of the admin navigation menu, replacing the default logo for every admin user. Added by the Element119 CustomAdminLogo module. Global (default) scope.

comment: Default email domain used by the Create New Account flow for this store.
modal: Provides a default email domain for the new-account creation flow. Website/store scoped, so it can differ per store view.

comment: Sets the merchant's country, which determines the PayPal solutions available to configure.
modal: The merchant's country of operation. PayPal offers country-specific payment solutions, so this controls which PayPal methods appear and can be configured. If left unset, the Default Country from General config is used. Website scope.

comment: Days a PayPal order authorization stays honored; must match your PayPal account setting.
modal: The authorization honor period (in days) that PayPal guarantees funds for an order authorization. Applies only when Payment Action is **Order**, and it must mirror the value configured on your PayPal account. Website scope.

comment: Background color for the PayPal-hosted checkout/payment pages.
modal: Sets the page background color shown on the PayPal-hosted (Payflow) checkout and payment pages, so they can match your store's look. Part of the Frontend Experience styling; applies per store view.

comment: How often Magento fetches PayPal settlement reports.
modal: Frequency at which Magento retrieves settlement reports from PayPal via SFTP. PayPal retains these reports for 45 days, so fetch often enough to avoid gaps. Global (default) scope.

comment: Turns the PayPal Credit financing option on or off for Payflow Link express checkout.
modal: Yes/No toggle that enables the PayPal Credit (formerly Bill Me Later) financing button for Payflow Link express checkout, letting customers pay over time while you are paid up front. Website scope.

comment: TCP port of the proxy server used for Payflow Pro API calls (0-65535).
modal: The port of the proxy server Magento connects through for Payflow Pro API requests. Applies only when Use Proxy is enabled, and accepts a value from 0 to 65535. Website scope.

comment: Smallest order total for which Bank Transfer is offered at checkout.
modal: Orders whose total is below this amount will not see Bank Transfer as a payment option. Leave empty for no minimum. Website scope.

comment: Whether Cash On Delivery is offered to all countries or only selected ones.
modal: Chooses whether Cash On Delivery is available to all allowed countries or only to specific countries picked in 'Payment from Specific Countries'. Website scope.

comment: The countries Cash On Delivery is limited to.
modal: The list of countries allowed to use Cash On Delivery. Takes effect only when 'Payment from Applicable Countries' is set to specific countries. Website scope.

comment: Smallest order total for which Check / Money Order is offered at checkout.
modal: Orders whose total is below this amount will not see Check / Money Order as a payment option. Leave empty for no minimum. Website scope.

comment: Enables the Company Credit (B2B) payment method at checkout.
modal: Yes/No toggle that makes the Company Credit payment method available, letting approved B2B companies pay against a credit line. Provided by the Orangecat B2B suite. Website scope.

comment: The status assigned to new zero-total orders placed via Zero Subtotal Checkout.
modal: The order status given to new orders paid through Zero Subtotal Checkout (free orders), chosen from the available new/processing statuses. Website scope.

comment: Smallest order total for which Purchase Order is offered at checkout.
modal: Orders whose total is below this amount will not see Purchase Order as a payment option. Leave empty for no minimum. Website scope.

comment: The payment method name customers see at checkout for PayPal Payments Advanced.
modal: The label shown to customers for this method at checkout. Store-view scoped, so it can differ per store view; PayPal recommends setting it to "Debit or Credit Card".

comment: Turns the PayPal Credit financing option on or off for Express Checkout.
modal: Yes/No toggle that enables the PayPal Credit (formerly Bill Me Later) financing button for PayPal Express Checkout, letting customers pay over time while you are paid up front. Website scope.

comment: Name of the custom page style configured in your PayPal account for hosted pages.
modal: The page style name applied to PayPal-hosted merchant pages, matching a style created in your PayPal account profile. Part of Frontend Experience settings; applies per store view.

comment: How often (in minutes) completed cron history for the consumers group is purged.
modal: Interval, in minutes, between cleanups of the cron schedule history for the message-queue consumers group. Older success/failure records are removed on this cadence. Global scope.

comment: Whether the consumers cron group runs in its own PHP process.
modal: When **Yes**, jobs in the message-queue consumers cron group run in a separate process from other cron groups, isolating their execution. Global scope.

comment: Grace period (in minutes) before a pending default-group job is marked missed.
modal: If a scheduled job in the default cron group is not executed within this many minutes of its scheduled time, it is flagged as 'missed' rather than run. Global scope.

comment: How often (in minutes) the indexer cron group pre-generates its schedule entries.
modal: Interval, in minutes, at which Magento generates upcoming schedule rows for the index cron group. Global scope.

comment: How far ahead (in minutes) schedules are pre-generated for the translate_products group.
modal: The window, in minutes, for which Magento pre-generates upcoming schedule entries for the translate_products cron group. Global scope.

comment: How long (in minutes) successful job records are kept in the group's cron history.
modal: Retention, in minutes, for successfully completed job records in the translate_select_attributes cron group before they are cleaned up. Global scope.

comment: Allows the browser back/forward cache (bfcache) when serving pages through Varnish.
modal: Enables back/forward cache support so browsers can instantly restore pages on back/forward navigation. Applies only when the caching application is Varnish. See web.dev for details. Global scope.

comment: Uses the Varnish xkey vmod for tag-based cache invalidation instead of the default purge.
modal: When **Yes**, Magento uses the Varnish xkey vmod for more efficient, tag-based cache invalidation. Requires the xkey vmod to be installed in your Varnish instance. Global scope.
